$comment: The blocks: whole starting pages the init bin copies into a consumer's app, composed from the library alone. Each lists every file it writes, at its target path (app/** lands in the app router folder, components/** beside it). A file may belong to more than one block; init never overwrites, so the shared shell is written once. scripts/validate-blocks.mjs holds this file to the tree and the site's previews.

blocks.name: app-shell
blocks.label: App shell
blocks.description: The floating sidebar, a top bar with search, the AI entry and the colour mode, a page header, and an empty page with the spacing set.

blocks.name: dashboard
blocks.label: Dashboard
blocks.description: The app shell with a row of stats, two panels and a project table, stacking down to one column on a phone.

blocks.name: sign-in
blocks.label: Sign in
blocks.description: A centred sign-in card with email and password, remember me and a single sign-on route.
